xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5281: Commit attribution: stamp every agent and conversation commit with an Overdeck-Conversation / Overdeck-Agent trailer

plan.title: Commit attribution: stamp every agent and conversation commit with an Overdeck-Conversation / Overdeck-Agent trailer
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Nothing ties a commit to the Overdeck conversation or agent that made it, so a conversation working on a shared main cannot show only its own commits. The per-conversation Changes view (parent #5183, mockup approved 2026-11-14) needs exact attribution.
narratives.Proposal: Make the git shim on every agent's PATH add `--trailer "Overdeck-Agent: <agentId>"` (plus a per-call `-c trailer.Overdeck-Agent.ifexists=addIfDifferent`) to `git commit`, with the id written into the shim at launch. Give conversations a new trailer-only git shim beside their gh shim that adds `Overdeck-Conversation: <session name>` and refuses nothing. Probe `git commit -h` at launch and skip the trailer on git without `--trailer`. Add an async library reader `listAttributedCommits` in src/lib/git/attributed-commits.ts that filters `git log --no-merges --grep` by trailer and parses `diff-tree -z` file stats. Document the behavior in docs/WORKSPACES-AND-PROJECTS.md, docs/PIPELINE-GATES.md, reference/workers.mdx and changelog.d/pan-5281.md. Full detail, exact sh and before/after code: .pan/drafts/pan-5281.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No Changes view, HTTP route or UI (later issue).
- No attribution of uncommitted edits or of commits made before this ships.
- No change to remote (Fly) agent launchers.
- No git hook, and no persistent `git config` write of any `trailer.*` key; only the per-invocation `-c` is allowed.
- No trailer on merge, cherry-pick, revert, rebase or am; only `git commit`.
- The conversation git shim must not refuse any git command and must not run the branch check.
- No attribution for an absolute /usr/bin/git, git aliases, library git implementations, or the dashboard server's own commits.
- No removal of duplicate trailers already present in old commits.
- No rename of the LauncherConfig.ghShim field.
- No allowlist raise in scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt.

autoDecisions.summary: Write the agent id and conversation id into the shim at launch instead of reading OVERDECK_AGENT_ID / OVERDECK_CONVERSATION at commit time (revises PRD D-2).
autoDecisions.rationale: The gh shim already bakes its id for robustness; it makes attribution immune to env drift in harness shells and removes the 'both variables set' ambiguity. The baked value equals the exported env value at both call sites.

autoDecisions.summary: Prepend a per-invocation `-c trailer.<Key>.ifexists=addIfDifferent` (revises PRD D-4).
autoDecisions.rationale: Reproduced on git 2.43: the default addIfDifferentNeighbor duplicates the agent trailer when an amend follows a different trailer; the key-scoped -c prevents it and touches no persistent config.

autoDecisions.summary: Probe `git commit -h` for `--trailer` at launch and skip the trailer when absent (new D-10/FR-7).
autoDecisions.rationale: The shim otherwise only needs git 2.22; an unconditional --trailer would break every agent commit on git 2.22-2.31.

autoDecisions.summary: The reader filters with `git log --no-merges -E --grep`, confirms the trailer, then caps to maxCount in JS, and parses `git diff-tree -z` output (revises PRD WI-3).
autoDecisions.rationale: Capping in git before the trailer check returns too few results (reproduced: a newer body-only match takes the only slot); `--numstat -M` rename paths do not join with --name-status; merge diffs would mislead the Changes view.

autoDecisions.summary: Put the new agent-shim tests in a new launcher-git-guard-trailer.test.ts instead of extending the 590-line behavior test.
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps the existing file untouched (its tests must pass unchanged as FR-3 evidence) and isolates the ambient-env controls NFR-3 requires.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep the rename buildConversationGhShimLines -> buildConversationShimLines from the PRD.
autoDecisions.rationale: The function now writes two shims; there is one caller and one test importer, so the rename is cheap.

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-1 exactly. In src/lib/launcher-git-guard.ts: (1) move the `_overdeck_git_find_command() {` ... `}` lines verbatim into `const FIND_COMMAND_SHIM_LINES` and spread them back; (2) add the plain-sh `TRAILER_SH` constant and `trailerShimLines(key, value)` from the PRD — the rewrite is INLINE top-level sh (a POSIX function cannot change the script's "$@"); (3) add the launch-time probe `_OVERDECK_GIT_TRAILERS=0` + `case "$("$_OVERDECK_REAL_GIT" commit -h 2>&1)" in *--trailer*) _OVERDECK_GIT_TRAILERS=1 ;; esac` after `_OVERDECK_REAL_GIT=` and bake `_OVERDECK_GIT_TRAILERS="$_OVERDECK_GIT_TRAILERS"` into the heredoc; (4) insert `...trailerShimLines('Overdeck-Agent', agentId),` directly after the `_overdeck_git_command=` line and before the read-only/default split, so every commit exit site (guard-root passthrough, BRANCH_CHECK_SH exec, read-only execs) execs the rewritten args; (5) add the PAN-5281 paragraph to the module header comment. Write the new test file src/lib/__tests__/launcher-git-guard-trailer.test.ts with the nine tests listed in WI-1, using NFR-3 env isolation (fixture git with OVERDECK_PAN_GIT_OP=1, OVERDECK_AGENT_ID/OVERDECK_CONVERSATION deleted, fixed GIT_AUTHOR_*/GIT_COMMITTER_*). Regenerate the two inline snapshots in launcher-generator.test.ts (plan-abc and spec-123) with `-u` and confirm the diff contains only trailer lines. Do not edit launcher-git-guard-behavior.test.ts.

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-3 exactly. Create src/lib/git/attributed-commits.ts exporting AttributionKey, AttributedCommitFile, AttributedCommit and async listAttributedCommits({ repoPath, key, value, since?, maxCount? }). Use promisify(execFile) with `git -C <repoPath> -c log.showSignature=false`, maxBuffer 16 MiB; import nothing from other src/lib modules. Empty value -> []; no HEAD -> [] if `rev-parse --git-dir` succeeds, else rethrow. List with `git log HEAD --no-merges --no-color -E --grep=^<escKey>:[[:space:]]*<escValue>[[:space:]]*$ [--since=] --format=%H%x1f%s%x1f%aI%x1f%(trailers:key=<key>,valueonly,separator=%x1d)` with NO --max-count (git would cap before the trailer check), keep only lines whose trailer list includes the value, then take the first `maxCount ?? 200`. For each sha in that slice only, sequentially, parse `git diff-tree --root -r -M -z --no-commit-id --numstat` and `--name-status` exactly as the PRD describes (rename = empty path then old,new; key by new; binary '-' -> 0; R* -> R, A, D, everything else -> M). Add the module header comment. Write the test file with the five-commit fixture plus a --no-ff merge, under NFR-3 env isolation.

items.title: Given the PRD's five-commit fixture plus a --no-ff merge whose message carries `Overdeck-Conversation: conv-a`, when listAttributedCommits is called with key Overdeck-Conversation and value conv-a, then it returns exactly commits 4 and 1 in that order (newest first), excluding the body-only commit 5 and the merge

When the same call returns, then commit 4's files include `{ path: 'b.txt', status: 'R' }` with the additions and deletions git reports and the binary file as `{ status: 'A', additions: 0, deletions: 0 }`, and the root commit 1's files are exactly `[{ path: 'a.txt', status: 'A', ... }]`

When called with `maxCount: 1`, then it returns exactly commit 4 even though the newer commit 5 matches the grep through its body; when called on a repository with no commits or with an empty value, then it returns []; when called on a directory that is not a git repository, then the promise rejects
When `rg "execSync|spawnSync|execFileSync" src/lib/git/attributed-commits.ts` runs, then it finds no match, and `npm run lint` (including lint:circular) exits 0
